notes.title: Ever changing
notes.notes:
Klux Island will constantly change. Sometime limited events will appear, some others will be gone forever. You might have a different understanding of the world depending on when you play it.

Today’s change: The bunny gang in Akagi Village have decorated their hideout. Also, an strange place has been discovered, the belongings of someone everyone has forgotten about can be seen in the Island… Who would it be…?
